# HIGH RISK FOR SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS ANTIBIOTIC PROPHYLAXIS

**Des Moines Guidance:**

REFER TO SYNDROME OR INFECTIOUS DISEASE FOR RECOMMENDATIONS Recommendations based on isolation of this specific pathogen are not available.
Please refer to the syndrome or infectious disease caused by this pathogen for antimicrobial therapy recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

Antibiotic prophylaxis is recommended for prevention of infection for the listed high risk conditions:

1. Extensive inflammatory skin disease (e.g. high tension)
2. Groin or Lower Extremities
3. Skin flaps and grafts
4. Wedge excision of lip or ear

Contaminated, dirty or infected wound may warrant antibiotic prophylaxis if patient is not currently on an antimicrobial for treatment of infection at the surgical site. Surgical prophylaxis is covered by antimicrobials for treatment of infection at time of surgery. No additional antimicrobials are necessary.

References:

- Bratzler et al, Am J Health-Syst Pharm (2013) 70, 195-283
- Rosengren et al, Curr Derm Rep (2012) 1, 55-63
- Rosengren et al, Am J Clin Dermatol (2010) 11.1, 35-44
- Up-to-Date article: Antimicrobial prophylaxis for prevention of surgical site infection in adults
- Up-to-Date article: Skin surgery: Prevention and treatment of complications
- Wright et al, J Am Acad Dermatol (2008) 59, 464-73
Therapy:
**Minneapolis Guidance:**

## Preferred

Cephalexin 2 GM PO ONCE - 1 hour prior to procedure ($) R

## MRSA risk factor

Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO 60 minutes before incision ($)

[R,DI] < AND > penicillin VK 500 mg PO 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]

## Unable to take oral medications

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

## MRSA risk factors and unable to take oral medications

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)
